Name: Hadoram, Officer of Tribute
Summary: Hadoram was over the tribute under Rehoboam; when the king sent him to Israel, the children of Israel stoned him to death.
KeyStory: King Rehoboam sent Hadoram that was over the tribute, and Israel stoned him, so Rehoboam fled to Jerusalem.
LifeLesson: A harsh answer to a weary people can turn a mission of peace into violence.
